visual_logic.surface_detail: Uniform 'Silver-Blue' metallic scales with a delicate and streamlined texture, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The short, blunt snout, tiny fine teeth, and oversized eye are oriented perfectly parallel to the camera plane.
visual_logic.facial_expression: Wide-eyed and alert with a 'startled' but soulful look, adjusted to face cleanly from a lateral perspective.

environment.water: Sun-drenched upper water column with suspended 'Cream White' chalk dust, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The massive floating rafts of sea lilies (Crinoids) and blurred schooling individuals in the bait ball are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The predatory ichthyodectid fish is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic mid-turn schooling pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its blunt head, streamlined torso, fins (flattened toward the camera plane), and deeply forked tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
